senses.gloss: (Saf. of נ־קף, v. נָקַף II) to go around.
to come in turn; to be arranged; to happen (cmp. סִבָּה);

units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 349">Sifré Deut. 349</cite> ed. Fr. <he>נִסְתַּקְּפָה</he>, v. <cite ref="O01480"><he>סְקִיפַנְטְיָא</he></cite>; ed. Radwill a. oth. <he>סקפנטיס נִיסְתַּקַּפְתָּ לו</he> (not <he>טום …</he>) thou hast turned informer against him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 954">Yalk. Deut. 954</cite> <he>תסקופים ניסתקפת לו</he> (some ed. <he>תשק׳</he>, read <he>נִיסתַּקְּפוּ</he>), v. <cite ref="V00770"><he>תּסְקוּפִים</he></cite>.
